purpose: Teach: オピニオン/図解/読み込み/終電/賃料/昇給/良品/単品

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界紙、オピニオン欄、注視しろ。
lines.en: Watch the trade press opinion columns.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. Sharp attack on the opening word. No room for questions. Eyes up, brief enough that it lands and moves on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品仕様、図解で、わかりやすく示します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make the product specs clear with diagrams.
lines.style: Steady, absorbing the instruction without defensiveness. Flat, professional pace. Voice lands on the commitment—no flourish, just competence being offered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の読み込み、ダブルチェック、徹底。
lines.style: Command-weight delivered quietly. Stress on 「ダブルチェック」 with mild emphasis. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone who's seen what happens when this step gets rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終電過ぎる残業、減らしていきます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll start cutting back on the overtime past last train.
lines.style: Accepting without excuse-making. Slight relief underneath—he's been noting this himself. Straightforward, almost grateful for permission to name it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 店舗の賃料、再交渉できるか。
lines.en: Can we renegotiate the store rent?
lines.style: Practical question, testing feasibility without judgment. Even pace. Genuine curiosity about options, not criticism. The tone of someone thinking through the numbers.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の昇給、計画的に進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with staff raises strategically.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slight warmth on the word 「昇給」—he notices this matters. Professional but not robotic. The pace of someone who's thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良品率、引き上げ、目標だ。
lines.en: Raising the quality rate is the target.
lines.style: Clear statement of priority. Delivered without urgency but with weight. Slight pause before 「目標」. The tone of someone setting the bar and expecting it to be met.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。単品売り、戦略的に進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll push single-item sales forward strategically.
lines.style: Final confirmation, matching the meeting's arc. Voice steady and closing. No new energy, just acknowledgment and commitment. The natural end of the exchange.
